process.title: How Booking Works
process.sub: A frictionless 4-step concierge service from your initial enquiry to the live pour on event day.

items.label: Initial Consultation
items.desc: Share your date, venue location, and estimated guest count.

items.label: Custom Menu Selection
items.desc: Choose your custom botanical flavors, lemon ginger zest, or spiced blends.

items.label: Farm Harvest Lock-In
items.desc: We reserve prime mature organic sugarcane harvested specifically for your event.

items.label: Live On-Site Pouring
items.desc: Our team arrives early with our polished press to delight your guests.

items.question: What power and space do you need at the venue?
items.answer: Our specialized commercial cold-press bars only require a standard 13A UK plug socket and a 2m x 2m flat floor space. We bring our own water supply and waste containers.

items.question: Can you cater outdoor weddings and garden parties?
items.answer: Yes! We operate indoor and outdoor events with all-weather vintage market canopies.

items.question: How far in advance should we book?
items.answer: We recommend booking 2 to 6 weeks in advance to guarantee fresh cane allocation, though we do accommodate short-notice bookings based on schedule.

items.question: Are your pressers hygiene certified?
items.answer: All our event artisans hold Level 2 Food Safety certification and adhere strictly to our 5-Star Food Hygiene rating.
